title: A verified nonprofit pays the $39 Non Profit plan: approval unlocks a Choose Non Profit checkout with the trial instead of granting the plan free
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20 (ADR-1811). PREMISE RE-TESTED on main: approveVerification called setSpacePlan(nonprofit, force) so approval granted the plan free. Now approval only marks verified; the billing page offers Choose Non Profit (trial included) to a verified free Space.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const miss=[];if(/setSpacePlan\\(/.test(r('lib/spaces/nonprofit-verification.ts')))miss.push('approval still grants the plan');if(!/'nonprofit'/.test(r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/choose-plan.tsx')))miss.push('ChoosePlanButton lacks nonprofit');if(!/plan=\"nonprofit\"/.test(r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/billing-body.tsx')))miss.push('billing page has no Choose Non Profit');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-994: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
